title: Senior Red Team Security Consultant, Mandiant, Google Cloud (English)
title_on_page: Senior Red Team Security Consultant, Mandiant, Google Cloud (English)

sections.minimum_qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
- 5 years of experience with engagement testing and red teaming functions including network, web application, mobile, cloud, social engineering, scripting, or tool development.
- Experience with tools used for wireless, web application, and network security testing.
- Ability to travel up to 30% as required.
- Ability to communicate in English fluently to work with internal partners and customer teams.
sections.preferred_qualifications:
- Certification in offensive security including OSCE, OSEP, OSEE, OSCP, CCSAS, CCT, INF; or related SysAdmin, Audit, Network and Security (SANS) courses.
- Experience with implementing or assessing information security implementation or assessing security controls.
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to develop documentation and explain technical details.
sections.about:
In this role, you will be responsible for assessing and advising clients on technical and process-based controls for all manner of environments. You will perform adversarial emulation of cyberattacks against customer organizations and other technical cyber security testing. You will expand the team’s capabilities through tool creation, research on techniques, internal presentations, and knowledge sharing.Part of Google Cloud, Mandiant is a recognized leader in dynamic cyber defense, threat intelligence and incident response services. Mandiant's cybersecurity expertise has earned the trust of security professionals and company executives around the world. Our unique combination of renowned frontline experience responding to some of the most complex breaches, nation-state grade threat intelligence, machine intelligence, and the industry's best security validation ensures that Mandiant knows more about today's advanced threats than anyone.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Learn more about benefits at Google.
sections.responsibilities:
- Perform Red and Purple Team assessments, assumed breach assessments (e.g., Red Team engagements with a pre-deployed implant), ransomware readiness reviews (e.g., assessing susceptibility to modern ransomware threats), threat analysis, and social engineering assessments.
- Conduct external and internal wireless assessments, web and mobile application testing, and embedded system assessments.
- Recognize and utilize attacker tools, tactics, and procedures.

description_text:
Minimum qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
- 5 years of experience with engagement testing and red teaming functions including network, web application, mobile, cloud, social engineering, scripting, or tool development.
- Experience with tools used for wireless, web application, and network security testing.
- Ability to travel up to 30% as required.
- Ability to communicate in English fluently to work with internal partners and customer teams.
Preferred qualifications:
- Certification in offensive security including OSCE, OSEP, OSEE, OSCP, CCSAS, CCT, INF; or related SysAdmin, Audit, Network and Security (SANS) courses.
- Experience with implementing or assessing information security implementation or assessing security controls.
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to develop documentation and explain technical details.
About the job
In this role, you will be responsible for assessing and advising clients on technical and process-based controls for all manner of environments. You will perform adversarial emulation of cyberattacks against customer organizations and other technical cyber security testing. You will expand the team’s capabilities through tool creation, research on techniques, internal presentations, and knowledge sharing.Part of Google Cloud, Mandiant is a recognized leader in dynamic cyber defense, threat intelligence and incident response services. Mandiant's cybersecurity expertise has earned the trust of security professionals and company executives around the world. Our unique combination of renowned frontline experience responding to some of the most complex breaches, nation-state grade threat intelligence, machine intelligence, and the industry's best security validation ensures that Mandiant knows more about today's advanced threats than anyone.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
US: $138000 - $200000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits
Learn more about benefits at Google.
Responsibilities
- Perform Red and Purple Team assessments, assumed breach assessments (e.g., Red Team engagements with a pre-deployed implant), ransomware readiness reviews (e.g., assessing susceptibility to modern ransomware threats), threat analysis, and social engineering assessments.
- Conduct external and internal wireless assessments, web and mobile application testing, and embedded system assessments.
- Recognize and utilize attacker tools, tactics, and procedures.
